docs/HANDOFF-2026-07-28-open-work.md:~71 — the never-run-alembic-downgrade rule lives only in the handoff
items.note: CLAUDE.md migration-invariants section covers NOT VALID/VALIDATE and seeds but not downgrade.

apk_to_main_diff: INSTALLED APK COMMIT IS UNKNOWN (W0 owner pre-flight not done). The list below is every technician-app/ path in changedFiles.txt (11 paths, 932 insertions / 69 deletions) with what changed per gitLog.txt; any of these may or may not be in the field build.

technician-app/eas.json — a31924a (#176): adds EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN with a real value to the preview and production env blocks. EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL lines are unchanged (preview still points at the efficient-tenderness Railway URL; production is the api.fixflow.example placeholder).

technician-app/src/features/jobs/CompleteJobScreen.tsx — da988e2 (#170): completion form resolves prefill before typing (blocked on queued or unknown, cache fallback with stale banner), splits machine remarks from free text, carries fault/action/audio ids, shows the server's own failure reason instead of 'check your connection'.
technician-app/src/features/jobs/completionPrefill.ts (new) + completionPrefill.test.ts (new) — da988e2: pure prefill/freeze decision logic and its Jest tests.
technician-app/src/features/jobs/arrival-job/wizardState.ts (new) + wizardState.test.ts (new) — da988e2: monotonic run/pending/failed/done state derived from outbox and server truth, with tests.

technician-app/src/features/jobs/arrival-job/ArrivalJobWizard.tsx — da988e2: uses wizardState via derive(), listens to onOutboxChange and onOutboxItemLanded, adds a failed state; capture-flow anchor/evidence logic unchanged.
technician-app/src/features/jobs/arrival-job/ArrivalAlreadyDoneScreen.tsx — da988e2: adds a 'failed' state with the server reason; correction CTA offered only for done or failed, not while pending.
technician-app/src/features/jobs/JobDetailScreen.tsx — da988e2: discarding a failed completion now also clears the arrival draft (discardCompletionAware).
technician-app/src/features/jobs/create-job/CreateJobWizard.tsx — 24184b2 (#173): WhatsApp consent state defaults to false (was true).
technician-app/src/features/jobs/create-job/CreateJobStep4.tsx — 24184b2 (#173): consent toggle copy renamed to 'WhatsApp updates / Customer agreed to receive job updates from us on WhatsApp'.

NOT changed since the handoff (no path in changedFiles): technician-app/src/features/attendance/* (geofence, punch, presence, ping queues and syncs), travelTracker/travelQueue/travelSync, lib/outbox.ts, lib/outboxSync.ts, lib/syncClassification.ts, lib/api.ts, lib/jobsCache.ts, lib/jobsReconcile.ts, features/media/*, app.json, package.json. So the geofence, location-tracking and offline-queue behaviour on main is identical to the handoff baseline.
summary: 66 register items classified against main (0578773; last code commit a31924a). Counts: FIXED 17, PARTIAL 7, OPEN 30, UNCHANGED_SINCE_HANDOFF 11, UNCLEAR 1 (sum 66). FIXED: S3-1, S3-2, S3-4, A1, A6, B1, B3, C1, C2, C5, T44-identity-1, T44-messaging-2, T44-messaging-3, T44-messaging-4, T44-ops-1, 45-4, ADR-3. PARTIAL: S3-3, A2, B2, 45-5, 52-4, LT-1, ADR-2. UNCLEAR: S3-5, a prod-data audit. UNCHANGED (no intersection with changedFiles, one hop checked): A3, A4, T44-web-1..4, T44-mobile-1, 45-2, L1, L3, L7. Everything else is OPEN: code re-read where the one-hop check hit a changed file (usually only main.py or jobs/service.py dispatcher hunks) and the cited defect is still present. Id note: T44 ids use a per-slice ordinal in table order (T44-identity-1, T44-media-3, etc.). Fixes since the handoff cluster in WhatsApp dispatcher hardening (B1-B3, 0046), unauthenticated-availability holes (A1, A6, non-ASCII secrets), login-lock recovery, and mobile completion guards (C1, C2, C5). No commit touched attendance, geofence, location-tracking or the offline queue/sync engine. Production is unreachable, so the installed APK commit and prod state (0045 vs 0046) are unestablished. Judgement of severity or ordering is left to a later stage.
